He killed their Emperor Argall and founded the Coalition of Planets. And just to show how serious he is about trying to stop the Viltrumites, the guy created the Scourge Virus.

Beyond just keeping him alive, though, this mechanical body packs one hell of a punch. Never underestimate what Robot is capable of.

We don’t know much about the world he comes from, but we do know that he killed his own dad.
